decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks match the post-pandemic demand for representative, flexible workplaces, so the line stays despite its four-year age.
A chair family is a core product, serving both residential and contract customers, and is typically kept for many years in premium furniture ranges.
Carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory at risk of pruning, but they add sustainability value by reusing rug materials at low cost.
The sofa is close to the core business, though its weak web emphasis and age raise the chance it is replaced by newer upholstery models.
A high standing table supports the flexible office and lounge settings the firm targets and costs little to keep in the range.
The rug collection was positioned as a flagship of the firm's direction and supports related products such as the cushions, so management continues it.
